neo4j.rationale: Derived topology index and graph authority lane

engram_embed.rationale: Engram MCP / TurboVec sidecar for bounded context memory

graphify_startup.rationale: Graphify startup is part of the full workstation readiness contract

notes: Full workstation profile keeps the graph authority, retrieval and cache lanes online.

engram_embed.rationale: Engram MCP / TurboVec sidecar is required

graphify_startup.rationale: Graphify startup is disabled in engram-only mode

notes: Engram-only mode suppresses Redis, Qdrant, Neo4j and Graphify as policy-disabled.

postgres.rationale: Local development still relies on the canonical DB

redis.rationale: Useful warm cache, but not mandatory in development

qdrant.rationale: Semantic retrieval lane, but dev can run degraded

neo4j.rationale: Graph lane can be offline while iterating locally

ollama.rationale: Local model runtime is required for app workflows

engram_embed.rationale: Sidecar accelerates memory and ANN routing when present

graphify_startup.rationale: Graphify startup can be present but is not mandatory during dev

notes: Development mode tolerates missing derived stores but still treats Postgres and Ollama as required.

postgres.rationale: Fixture jobs may use a mocked or ephemeral DB

ollama.rationale: Fixture tests may stub the model runtime

engram_embed.rationale: Fixture tests may stub the 8792 sidecar

graphify_startup.rationale: Fixture runs do not need graphify startup

notes: CI fixture mode must not turn missing live services into a hard failure.
